cases.why: the audit workflow goes back to @v1: whoever can move that tag decides what code reads every PR with this repository's token, and nothing in a diff here would show the change
a seven-character SHA looks pinned and is not a full commit id; GitHub resolves only full SHAs as immutable
the SHA is right but nothing says which release it is, so the next update has to look it up, and a reader cannot tell a current pin from a two-year-old one
one workflow moves to a different commit of the action and the others do not, so the same step behaves differently depending on which workflow ran it
the job that publishes the site checks out with @v6 again: the first step of the job, with its token in reach, is whatever that tag points at today
